svg.title: K29: one unready container makes the whole Pod 1/2
svg.desc: The Pod has two containers sharing a folder. The web container writes access.log and is Ready. The log-shipper has a typo in LOG_FILE, acess.log, so it waits for a file that never appears and is not Ready. One unready container makes the Pod 1 of 2, not Ready, and the Service has no endpoints.

svg.text: READY 1/2 and the Pod is not Ready. The web logs look fine. Check each container: kubectl logs <pod> -c log-shipper.

svg.text: Correct LOG_FILE to access.log. The shipper finds the file, turns Ready, the Pod becomes 2/2.
